integrity: The classification is proved symbolically by the complete-sequence criterion and an exhaustive partition of \(\Omega(n)\le4\). The bundled computation checks a finite range only as regression evidence and is not used to infer the unbounded theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the first composite multiplicity layer of s-practical numbers. It does not classify cases with \(\Omega(n)\ge5\). The closely related 2026 Reuijl thesis was identifiable but its full text was not available for inspection; indexed metadata attributes to it a prime-power exclusion, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed equivalent low-multiplicity statement.
title: The first composite multiplicity layer of \(s\)-practical numbers
